definitions.gloss: setting a question; posing a problem; giving a quiz
definitions.explanation: The act of creating and presenting questions or problems, especially in exams, quizzes, or competitions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{出題|しゅつだい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
{出題|しゅつだい}⟦{範囲|はんい}→範囲：03567_hani⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{教科書|きょうかしょ}→教科書：01085_kyoukasho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧3⟦{章|しょう}→章：03768_shou⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧です。
examples.english: The exam covers up to chapter 3 of the textbook.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{入試|にゅうし}→入試：04705_nyuushi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{出題|しゅつだい}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧らしい。
examples.english: Apparently difficult questions were set in this year's entrance exam.

notes:
A compound of {出|しゅつ} (put out) + {題|だい} (question/topic). Refers to creating and presenting questions in exams, quizzes, or competitions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {出題|しゅつだい}⟦{範囲|はんい}→範囲：03567_hani⟧: scope of the exam
- {出題|しゅつだい}⟦{傾向|けいこう}→傾向：02695_keikou⟧: question trends/patterns
- {出題|しゅつだい}{者|しゃ}: question setter
- {出題|しゅつだい}⟦{形式|けいしき}→形式：00211_keishiki⟧: question format
- {出題|しゅつだい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to set questions
- {出題|しゅつだい}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: questions are set (passive)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {出題|しゅつだい}: setting questions (examiner side)
- ⟦{解答|かいとう}→解答：00447_kaitou⟧: answering (test-taker side)
